settings.heading: Golf has a dress code. Ours is gold
settings.lede: Clubs nobody mistakes for anyone else's.

settings.heading: Luck favors the bold
settings.body:
Golf's the best game there is, and it should feel that way whether it's your first round or your five hundredth. Somewhere along the way it got stiff and way too expensive. We're here to loosen it up.

That starts with clubs that forgive the swings you're still working on, cost what they should, and look like nothing else in the bag.

Nobody here cares about your handicap or whether your polo's tucked in. Show up, swing hard, talk a little trash.

And when the chip drops and somebody asks what you're hitting, tell them it's your lucky wedge. Whether it was luck is your business.

settings.heading: Great clubs got too expensive. We took it personally
settings.text: The big names sponsor a tour pro and add it to your price. We skipped that part, so you get the same materials and none of the markup.

settings.heading: Same steel as the big names. Different math
settings.text: Every club gets sixty days to make up your mind, and if it doesn't earn its spot in the bag, send it back.

settings.heading: We built the clubs we wanted
settings.text: In 2018 we made one gold wedge, built right and priced honestly. It hit.

settings.heading: Gold, on purpose.
settings.lede: You only get so many Saturdays, and none of them should be spent blending in.

settings.heading: How a gold wedge turned into all this
settings.lede: It started with one gold wedge and escalated from there.

settings.title: The gold wedge
settings.text: One wedge, in gold. Lucky starts here.

settings.title: The Blade putter
settings.text: Fully milled, and quiet off the face. Turns out people wanted more than a wedge.

settings.title: Wedges, version two
settings.text: The original, refined and re-released. The gold wedge wasn't a fluke.

settings.title: The Mallet putter
settings.text: Bigger head, fewer excuses on the greens.

settings.title: The hybrid
settings.text: Titanium with a flex-channel face, for the gap your long irons never covered.

settings.title: Somebody hit the gas
settings.text: Lucky changed hands. Nothing happened to the clubs or the prices. Everything happened to the calendar.

settings.title: The polos drop
settings.text: The clubs got a wardrobe. Same rule: look good, priced fair.

settings.title: Hats land
settings.text: Ten ways to keep the sun off while you take someone's money.

settings.title: The Patriot putter
settings.text: A limited run for America's 250th. Gone when it's gone.

settings.title: Nine of us now
settings.text: Nine people where there used to be a lot fewer. That's what shipping this much at once actually takes.

settings.title: First accessories drop
settings.text: Towels, divot tools, new headcovers. The little stuff, done right.

settings.title: KBS shafts
settings.text: A name shaft across the line, for everyone who has opinions about shafts.

settings.title: Irons and drivers
settings.text: The big sticks arrive. Years of asking, answered.

settings.title: Just getting started
settings.text: Partnerships, and a few drops we're not allowed to describe yet.

settings.title: The clubs
settings.text: Every club we make, starting at $99.

settings.title: Ambassador program
settings.text: Post about Lucky and we put ad money behind your videos. No follower minimum.

settings.title: Questions
settings.text: Shipping, returns, what happens if the fit's wrong, and how the sixty days work.

settings.heading: “It's better to be lucky.”
settings.lede: Tell them where you got it.
